name: bg_skylift
prompt: 16-bit pixel art background layer for a 2D side-scrolling action game. Flat straight-on side elevation view, one continuous horizontal panorama spread evenly across the full width, no vignette, no frame, no characters, no creatures, no text, no UI. Distant scenery only, soft atmospheric haze, muted low-contrast colours so foreground sprites stand out, bottom quarter fades into plain dark shadow. Crisp chunky pixels, limited palette, retro console game art. Scene: high above the clouds at dawn, a giant steel cable-lift line climbing diagonally through layered sunlit cloud banks. Tall lattice pylons with blinking lamps, thick cables, small empty gondolas far away, and the faint outline of a floating white-and-gold city on anti-gravity pylons high on the horizon. Below the clouds a rusty junk town glows through gaps. Pale cyan sky, cream and peach clouds, small gold lights.
